frame.converter: Each sky position onto the midplane of the inclined disc M31's image layers are baked on (recipe.json), through the image-layer bake's own intersection.

discThickness.basis: Braun (1991, Sect. 5.3, eq. 13) fits M31's H I layer with an exponential whose scale height rises linearly with radius, 182 + 16 R_kpc pc (about 340 pc at the 10 kpc star-forming ring), with considerable scatter. It is the gas these young objects form from; young stars sit in the cold, thinner part of it, so for them it is an upper value, used as a presentation choice. Each row's own height is drawn, not measured.

meaning: Supernova remnant candidates found by Lee & Lee (2014) in the Local Group Galaxies Survey H-alpha and [S II] images: one dot per candidate at its catalogue sky position.

appearance.note: Presentation only: the supernova-remnant colour of the M33 dots, so the two galaxies read alike. Each dot takes its tone and half its colour from the photograph under it (packages/bake/cli/prepare-catalogue-points.mts).
